title: gleditsia triacanthos var. aquatica
intro: Gleditsia triacanthos var. aquatica, commonly known as waterhickory, is a variety of the hickory tree that is native to eastern North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of waterhickory include its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and swelling, as well as its potential to act as a natural laxative and diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
